description: Minimal vector illustrating how bidi control characters can affect visual order without changing logical code point order. Intended for tooling diagnostics, not for normalization-form equivalence.

example.note: This vector does not attempt to reproduce a complete Trojan Source attack; it captures the presence of bidi controls as a detectable condition.

assertions.normalization_forms_apply: Normalization (UAX #15) does not remove bidi controls by definition; mitigation is typically by restricting/diagnosing these characters per UTS #55/UAX #31 profiles.
